allocation.objective: story posts with a hard CTA

rationale: Day 1 showed X converting at the lowest cost per signup and LinkedIn at the highest. Money moves to X and Instagram; LinkedIn drops to a keep-alive budget until a post there earns it back.
message_to_team: Board, budget moved: X to 55 percent, Instagram 40, LinkedIn cut to 5. Mei's numbers said X converts cheapest; I expect cost per signup to fall toward EUR 3.20.
